title: 나중에 뭐가 되고 싶어요? 꿈과 미래 이야기
objective: By the end, you can use ten future words, such as 꿈, 나중에, and 졸업하다, in short sentences. You can also say what you want to become with N이/가 되고 싶어요.
summary: Learn ten basic words for talking about your dreams, plans, and life in the future.

task.title: Choose, fill in, order
task.line: Use the word list on page 1 to choose the right word, fill in each blank, or put the words in order.

words.meaning: the future (in general, for people or the world)
words.exampleMeaning: I think about the children's future.
I'm busy now. Let's talk later.

words.meaning: a dream; something you hope to do or become
words.exampleMeaning: My dream is to be a singer.

words.meaning: to become (N이/가 되다: 이 after a consonant, 가 after a vowel)
words.exampleMeaning: What do you want to be later?
I graduate from university in February.
I'm coming to Korea again next year.
What are your plans for the weekend?

words.meaning: studying abroad (유학을 가다: to go abroad to study)
words.exampleMeaning: I want to go to Korea to study.

words.meaning: an office worker; a company employee
words.exampleMeaning: My older brother is an office worker.
My uncle got married this year.

exercises: Choose the right word: ① 지금은 배가 안 고파요. (나중에 / 미래) 먹어요. ② 여름 방학 (계획 / 회사원)이 있어요? ③ 제 (꿈 / 졸업)은 화가예요. ④ (미래 / 작년)에는 로봇이 요리를 할 거예요.
Fill in the blank with 이 or 가: ① 형은 경찰___ 되고 싶어요. ② 저는 의사___ 되고 싶어요.
Fill in the blank with one word from the list: 저는 작년에 고등학교를 ____했어요.
Fill in the blank with one word from the list: 올해는 2026년이에요. 2027년은 ____이에요.
Choose the right word: ① 미국 대학교에서 공부하고 싶어요. 그래서 (유학 / 결혼)을 가요. ② 아버지는 회사에 다녀요. 아버지는 (회사원 / 미래)이에요. ③ 언니는 다음 달에 남자 친구와 (결혼해요 / 졸업해요).
Put the words in order to make a sentence: 되고 싶어요 / 나중에 / 선생님이 / 저는
answers: ① 나중에 ② 계획 ③ 꿈 ④ 미래
① 유학 ② 회사원 ③ 결혼해요
저는 나중에 선생님이 되고 싶어요. (나중에 저는 선생님이 되고 싶어요.)
